page.title: Devices
page.description: Each device has its own subscription URL and follows every upstream or a chosen few. Common entries go to every device.

empty: No devices yet. Add one and give its URL to TVBox.
name: Name
followAll: Follow every upstream, including ones added later
commonHint: Common entries (added in Content, not from an upstream) are always included.
previewHint: Built from the current, unpublished state.
deleteDescription: "{{name}}" loses its subscription within a minute.

url.title: Subscription
url.description: Enter this URL in TVBox as the configuration address.
url.rotateDescription: "{{name}}" stops working with its current URL within a minute and needs the new one.
url.unavailable: This device was created before URLs were kept. Regenerate to get one.

enroll.pendingHint: Approve only codes you can see on your own screen (Settings → Server link). The device picks up its subscription within 15 seconds.
enroll.approved: Approved; the device loads its subscription shortly
enroll.approveHint: Create a device for it, or attach it to an existing one.
